artifact.summary: No circuit was generated. The specification only contains asymptotic query-complexity bounds (eq_1, eq_2). It gives no walk operator, span program, oracle encoding, register layout or inter-query unitaries, so a faithful NAND-formula-evaluation circuit cannot be built without inventing the algorithm.

equation_mapping.explanation: Asymptotic query bound O(sqrt(N)) for balanced binary NAND formulas. It is a complexity claim, not a unitary or gate sequence, so it cannot be implemented as a circuit.
Asymptotic query bound N^(1/2+O(1/sqrt(log N))) for arbitrary binary NAND formulas. The exponent was read from a garbled abstract. It is a complexity claim with no operation to implement.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to nothing: no construction was implemented and the artifact abstains with empty code.
specification_changes.reason: The specification supplies only complexity bounds. Its register sizes, steps and measurement were generic assumptions, not content from the source. Implementing them would mean fabricating the algorithm.

unresolved_issues: The algorithm (quantum walk or span program on the formula tree) is not specified.
The oracle encoding of the input bits and the register layout are unspecified.
The unitaries between queries are unknown.
The formula-tree format and the instance parameters are undefined.
The exponent in eq_2 was garbled in the abstract.
No public validation contract was supplied to narrow the scope to a concrete, checkable circuit.
